description: Get the verbatim text of an Ohio Administrative Code rule (agency regulation, NOT a Revised Code statute) by rule number. "OAC 3701-32-02" is rule 3701-32-02 of the Department of Health lead-safe renovation chapter. Returns the heading, effective date, rule text (or just a requested subsection such as "3701-32-02(A)(1)") and the supplemental information (authorizing and amplified statutes, rule history). A number that does not exist answers found:false. Use for "text of OAC 3701-32-02", "Ohio Admin. Code 5101:1-1-01", or any Ohio agency-rule ask. Keyless.

rule.description: Rule number as cited, e.g. "3701-32-02", "5101:1-1-01", optionally with a subsection: "3701-32-02(A)(1)".

name: oh_admin_rule
title: Oh Admin Rule
